title: Pink Double Glass Shelf 22-Inch, Wall-Mounted Solid Brass Gallery Rail, Waverly Place Collection, Allied Brass
description: Double glass shelf for bathroom wall storage with gallery rail, sized 22 inches wide (22-inch, 22in) x 5 inches deep x 8 inches high in Pink, which brings playful, modern energy to bathroom design, offering a fresh take on hardware that celebrates individuality. This wall-mounted glass shelf uses 3/8-in (0.38 in) thick tempered glass for safety and strength and solid brass hardware for lasting durability. Use it as a bathroom shelf, glass shelf, or wall shelf for toiletries, bottles, and decor; the gallery rail helps keep items in place. Concealed screw mounting provides a clean, finished appearance; mounting type: wall mount. Weight capacity: 4 lb. Includes glass shelf and all installation hardware; screw size #8 x 1 1/4". Style: traditional with a versatile look that fits transitional bath accessories and transitional bathroom hardware. Backed by a lifetime warranty. Allied Brass Waverly Place collection, matching Waverly Place pieces available.
